The '''Mercenary enclave''' was where [[Khoonda]], the government of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], allowed the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] on the planet to operate from after the [[Attack on Dantooine (Jedi Civil War)|bombardment of]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].

The camp was constructed in the remains of the [[Rakatan ruins (Dantooine)|Rakatan ruins]].

The enclave was probably destroyed after the [[Azkul's mercenaries|mercenaries]], led by [[Azkul]], were defeated during the [[Battle of Khoonda]].
